title: Application of emerging technologies in the antiviral field.
authors: Zhang, Xiaoyan; Zhang, Lele; Guo, Tengda; Du, Wenjuan; Wang, Shen; Li, Yongtao
one_liner_zh: 综述了器官模型、基因编辑、AI分子设计（含AlphaFold结构预测）和合成生物学在抗病毒领域的应用，虽涉及蛋白质结构预测但仅为宽泛综述，缺乏方法创新。
abstract: Viral diseases pose a serious threat to global public health, agriculture, and biosecurity. Conventional antiviral strategies are often limited by an incomplete understanding of disease mechanisms, poor targeting precision, and slow response times. Emerging technologies are now reshaping the landscape of antiviral research. This review examines the roles of four key frontiers, including organoid models, gene editing, AI-driven molecular design, and synthetic biology. Organoids provide physiologically relevant platforms that model virus-host interactions and disease progression. Viral infections remain a major challenge to human and animal health, agriculture, and biosecurity. Progress in antiviral research is constrained by the complexity of viral pathogenesis, the diversity and rapid evolution of viruses, and the limited translational relevance of some traditional model systems. Recent advances in organoid technology, gene editing, artificial intelligence, and synthetic biology are expanding the toolkit available for antiviral research and development. In this review, we discuss how these four technological frontiers contribute to disease modeling, target discovery, molecular design, and translational innovation. Organoids, in particular, provide physiologically relevant systems for investigating viral infection, tissue tropism, host responses, and pathogenesis. Gene editing tools, such as CRISPR, enable precise manipulation of host and viral genomes, facilitating the development of resistant organisms and next-generation vaccine platforms. AI technologies, including AlphaFold for structure prediction and platforms for de novo protein design, address long-standing bottlenecks in structural biology and offer powerful means to engineer antiviral proteins, antibodies, and vaccine antigens. Synthetic biology, guided by the Design-Build-Test-Learn cycle, integrates computational design, genetic assembly, and functional validation into a cohesive pipeline. Together, these technologies form a synergistic workflow that spans disease modeling, target discovery, molecular design, construction, testing, and iterative optimization. This integrated approach is shifting antiviral development from traditional empirical methods toward more precise, intelligent strategies. The review also highlights ongoing challenges in integration and scalability, stressing that high-quality biological datasets and stronger interdisciplinary collaboration are essential for realizing translational potential. By presenting a cohesive view of these converging methodologies, this review offers a framework to guide the intelligent evolution of antiviral strategies in both human and animal health.
abstract_zh: 病毒性疾病对全球公共卫生、农业及生物安全构成严重威胁。传统抗病毒策略常受限于对疾病机制的不完全理解、靶向精度不足及响应速度缓慢。新兴技术正在重塑抗病毒研究的格局。本综述探讨了四个关键前沿领域的作用，包括类器官模型、基因编辑、人工智能驱动的分子设计以及合成生物学。类器官提供了模拟病毒-宿主相互作用及疾病进展的生理相关平台。病毒感染仍是人类与动物健康、农业及生物安全面临的重大挑战。抗病毒研究的进展受限于病毒发病机制的复杂性、病毒的多样性与快速进化，以及某些传统模型系统的转化相关性有限。类器官技术、基因编辑、人工智能及合成生物学的最新进展正在拓展抗病毒研究与开发的工具库。在本综述中，我们讨论了这四个技术前沿如何促进疾病建模、靶点发现、分子设计及转化创新。特别是类器官，为研究病毒感染、组织嗜性、宿主反应及发病机制提供了生理相关系统。基因编辑工具（如CRISPR）能够精确操控宿主与病毒基因组，从而促进抗性生物体及下一代疫苗平台的开发。人工智能技术，包括用于结构预测的AlphaFold及用于从头蛋白质设计的平台，解决了结构生物学中长期存在的瓶颈，并为设计抗病毒蛋白、抗体及疫苗抗原提供了强大手段。合成生物学在“设计-构建-测试-学习”循环的指导下，将计算设计、基因组装及功能验证整合为一条连贯的流程。这些技术共同形成了一个协同工作流，涵盖疾病建模、靶点发现、分子设计、构建、测试及迭代优化。这种整合方法正将抗病毒开发从传统的经验方法转向更精确、更智能的策略。本综述还强调了整合与可扩展性方面的持续挑战，指出高质量生物数据集及更强的跨学科合作对于实现转化潜力至关重要。通过呈现这些汇聚方法的连贯视角，本综述提供了一个框架，以指导人类与动物健康领域抗病毒策略的智能化演进。
